name: Job Description NER Corpus
description: We present the development of a benchmark suite consisting of an annotation schema, training corpus and baseline model for Entity Recognition (ER) in job descriptions, published under a Creative Commons license. This was created to address the distinct lack of resources available to the community for the extraction of salient entities, such as skills, from job descriptions. The dataset contains 18.6k entities comprising five types (Skill, Qualification, Experience, Occupation, and Domain). We include a benchmark CRF-based ER model which achieves an F1 score of 0.59. Through the establishment of a standard definition of entities and training/testing corpus, the suite is designed as a foundation for future work on tasks such as the development of job recommender systems.
reputation: A respected, domain-specific resource in HR/recruitment NLP research used as a standard benchmark for extracting skills and other entities from job descriptions.
notes: Contains ~18.6k entities across five types; moderate size and domain-specific, with class imbalance potential and annotation variability. Baseline is a non-LLM CRF model (F1=0.59).
